children.title: FORMAT FOR NON-DEDUCTION ON ACCOUNT OF PAYMENT TERMS FOR PAYMENT THROUGH VIM.
children.content:
Project name
: Building Works for PP and CDW Units Including Civil, Structural and
Architectural Works, Lift, HVAC for PP and CDW Buildings for P-25 Project of IOCL PRPC

Nature of Contract : LSTKÆEPEM/CONVETIONAL
☒

This is to certify that Service entry sheet has been prepared in SAP as per the payment
terms applicable for each item for the above referred Work Order. Records of certified bill
are maintained in abstract sheet/billing schedule.

Therefore, there is no need to withhold any amount from invoices processed at VIM on
account of "Payment terms".

Any amount to be withheld on account of "Payment terms" shall be maintained by EIC in
VIM Dash Board as and when same is required.
children.summary: This document certifies that service entry sheets for the "Building Works for PP and CDW Units" project (P-25 Project of IOCL PRPC) have been prepared in SAP according to the applicable payment terms for each item. Records of certified bills are maintained in abstract sheets/billing schedules. Consequently, no amount needs to be withheld from invoices processed at VIM due to "Payment terms." Any necessary withholdings related to "Payment terms" will be managed by the EIC in the VIM Dashboard as required.

summary: This document confirms that service entry sheets for the "Building Works for PP and CDW Units" project (P-25 Project of IOCL PRPC) have been correctly processed in SAP, adhering to the specified payment terms for each item. Certified bill records are kept in abstract sheets/billing schedules. Therefore, no invoice amounts processed through VIM should be withheld due to "Payment terms." Any required withholdings related to "Payment terms" will be handled by the EIC directly within the VIM Dashboard.
